no head or tail fades: an intake master of a finished render leaves the waveform's edges as struck. The strike's own ending (programme above -40 dBFS to 179.14 s, last sample above -60 dBFS at 179.23 s, then one unbroken 2.536 s run of exact zeros to the file's end — a performed fade completed into a black tail) is the performance's, untouched.

nothing else rides and nothing was removed: no EQ, no width process, no edit of any kind between decode and the loudness/ceiling law — the one addition is the confessed Sigma fixture in the sigma block.

sigma.added_by: the desk, at the strike of the master, 2026-11-10
sigma.authority: the brief's own order (a binaural Sigma layer embedded through the track, sweeping 13-31 Hz) + the founder's embedded-Sigma standing order + the closed Fixtures A/B law (ear verdict 2026-11-10: a house Sigma pair may ride a Gemini master — studio-runs/gemini-hood-elegance/fixtures-ab/)
sigma.basis_in_the_strike: the strike's own ordered layer read NOT CERTIFIABLE by both probes (analysis-stats.json). Fixed seats at the doctrine pair: L @ 200 Hz median 2.96 dB, persistence 0.133; R @ 213 Hz median 3.95 dB, persistence 0.244 — the bar is >= 10 dB median AND >= 0.90 persistence in BOTH channels. Pair tracker: pair persistence 0.828 and median line ratios 14.03 dB (L) / 14.97 dB (R), but median interaural difference 1.5 Hz, |df| IQR 93.5 Hz, and only 1.3 % of pair windows inside 13-31 Hz (0.7 % within 13 +/- 2 Hz) — the tracked lines are the programme's own wandering tones (kick, bass, hat partials), not a binaural sweep holding a separation; persistence also falls short of the 0.90 rung.
sigma.confession: what rides is the house Proven Road pair — a CONSTANT 200/213 Hz pair beating at 13.0 Hz — the only Sigma form the house has proven. It occupies the ordered layer's place at the proven seats; it does not pretend the strike performed its own sweeping layer, which both probes read as absent at mastering depth.
sigma.recipe: the house Proven Road fixture, exactly as the prior Gemini masters rode it: constant sine pair, 200 Hz left / 213 Hz right (13.0 Hz binaural beat), amplitude = mastered-bed RMS x 10^(-28/20); mastered bed RMS 0.1508, pair amplitude 0.00600

residual_verification.method: fixtures method, run at the strike of the master: final minus pre-ride master is the Sigma layer alone, sample-aligned; per-window FFT peaks in 180-230 Hz read the pair at its seats. Peak-picking the mix itself would find the programme's tones, not the pair.
residual_verification.reading: every one of the 91 probed windows reads the pair at its seats; the residual's RMS (0.004246) equals the pair's own sine RMS (amplitude/sqrt(2) = 0.004243), i.e. the delivered master differs from the pre-Sigma master by the confessed fixture and by nothing else above 24-bit quantisation dust.

sigma.trim_after_ride: none applied and none needed: loudness measured -14.0 LUFS before the ride and -14.0 LUFS after it (the pair's contribution is below the manifest's 0.01 LU resolution).
